title: Workshop library
description: The registry at the root of a workshop library, `library.json`: the collections and catalogs its owner subscribes to, in order, where each collection's workshops are installed, and the projects whose workshops it shows. A workshops directory holding this file is a library; one without it behaves as a plain workshops directory.

collections.description: Subscribed collections, in the order the browser lists them: http(s) URLs of collection indexes, or paths relative to the JupyterLab root. When present, the list takes the place of the collections in the JupyterLab settings, as a user's own settings do; when absent, the settings apply.

catalogs.description: Subscribed catalogs, in order. When present, the list takes the place of the catalogs in the JupyterLab settings.

directories.description: The directory under `installed/` each collection's workshops are installed into, keyed by the collection's location. Chosen when the first workshop of a collection is installed, whether or not the library subscribes to it, and kept from then on so a later change to the collection does not move anything.

projects.description: Projects that need saying something about. A directory under `projects/` is a project without an entry; an entry names a different workshops directory, or links in a directory kept outside the library.

target.description: For a project linked in from outside the library, the absolute path of the directory `projects/<name>` links to.

workshops.description: The project's workshops directory, relative to the project. Defaults to `workshops`.
